name: Miami-Dade County, Florida (United States)
description: White field with a saltire of light blue and green, charged at the centre with the county seal.
history: Miami-Dade County is the most populous county in Florida. Flags of the World records an earlier blue flag with the pre-1957 seal, relinquished when the metropolitan government was installed in 1957 and later replaced by a flag similar to the present one.

features.role: saltire of light blue and green
